name: Kanrika!
source:
Five employees in the management section are suddenly informed about restructuring! The only way to save the job is to get to the top in the company!

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
管理部门的五名员工突然被告知公司要重组！拯救工作的唯一方法，就是在公司里一路晋升到顶层！

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
